a: git bisect run can automate finding the first bad commit.
git worktree add creates a linked working tree for another branch.
Sparse checkout limits which paths are in the working tree.
Git notes attach extra data to objects without changing hashes.
git replace can substitute objects for history surgery (advanced).
git-filter-repo is the modern tool to rewrite history safely.
Use Git LFS or external storage for large binaries.
Commit templates remind authors of message structure.
Pre-commit hooks run checks before a commit is created.
A global gitignore covers OS junk across all repos.
